vulg: quod fuit ab initio quod audivimus quod vidimus oculis nostris quod perspeximus et manus nostrae temptaverunt de verbo vitae
clem: Quod fuit ab initio, quod audivimus, quod vidimus oculis nostris, quod perspeximus, et manus nostr contrectaverunt de verbo vit:
tr: ο ην απ αρχης ο ακηκοαμεν ο εωρακαμεν τοις οφθαλμοις ημων ο εθεασαμεθα και αι χειρες ημων εψηλαφησαν περι του λογου της ζωης
kjv: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

vulg: et vita manifestata est et vidimus et testamur et adnuntiamus vobis vitam aeternam quae erat apud Patrem et apparuit nobis
clem: et vita manifestata est, et vidimus, et testamur, et annuntiamus vobis vitam ternam, qu erat apud Patrem, et apparuit nobis:
tr: και η ζωη εφανερωθη και εωρακαμεν και μαρτυρουμεν και απαγγελλομεν υμιν την ζωην την αιωνιον ητις ην προς τον πατερα και εφανερωθη ημιν
kjv: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

vulg: quod vidimus et audivimus adnuntiamus et vobis ut et vos societatem habeatis nobiscum et societas nostra sit cum Patre et cum Filio eius Iesu Christo
clem: quod vidimus et audivimus, annuntiamus vobis, ut et vos societatem habeatis nobiscum, et societas nostra sit cum Patre, et cum Filio ejus Jesu Christo.
tr: ο εωρακαμεν και ακηκοαμεν απαγγελλομεν υμιν ινα και υμεις κοινωνιαν εχητε μεθ ημων και η κοινωνια δε η ημετερα μετα του πατρος και μετα του υιου αυτου ιησου χριστου
kjv: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

vulg: et haec scribimus vobis ut gaudium nostrum sit plenum
clem: Et hc scribimus vobis ut gaudeatis, et gaudium vestrum sit plenum.
tr: και ταυτα γραφομεν υμιν ινα η χαρα ημων  υμων  η πεπληρωμενη
kjv: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

vulg: et haec est adnuntiatio quam audivimus ab eo et adnuntiamus vobis quoniam Deus lux est et tenebrae in eo non sunt ullae
clem: Et hc est annuntiatio, quam audivimus ab eo, et annuntiamus vobis: quoniam Deus lux est, et tenebr in eo non sunt ull.
tr: και αυτη εστιν η επαγγελια  αγγελια  ην ακηκοαμεν απ αυτου και αναγγελλομεν υμιν οτι ο θεος φως εστιν και σκοτια εν αυτω ουκ εστιν ουδεμια
kjv: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

vulg: si dixerimus quoniam societatem habemus cum eo et in tenebris ambulamus mentimur et non facimus veritatem
clem: Si dixerimus quoniam societatem habemus cum eo, et in tenebris ambulamus, mentimur, et veritatem non facimus.
tr: εαν ειπωμεν οτι κοινωνιαν εχομεν μετ αυτου και εν τω σκοτει περιπατωμεν ψευδομεθα και ου ποιουμεν την αληθειαν
kjv: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

vulg: si autem in luce ambulemus sicut et ipse est in luce societatem habemus ad invicem et sanguis Iesu Filii eius mundat nos ab omni peccato
clem: Si autem in luce ambulamus sicut et ipse est in luce, societatem habemus ad invicem, et sanguis Jesu Christi, Filii ejus, emundat nos ab omni peccato.
tr: εαν δε εν τω φωτι περιπατωμεν ως αυτος εστιν εν τω φωτι κοινωνιαν εχομεν μετ αλληλων και το αιμα ιησου χριστου του υιου αυτου καθαριζει ημας απο πασης αμαρτιας
kjv: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

vulg: si dixerimus quoniam peccatum non habemus ipsi nos seducimus et veritas in nobis non est
clem: Si dixerimus quoniam peccatum non habemus, ipsi nos seducimus, et veritas in nobis non est.
tr: εαν ειπωμεν οτι αμαρτιαν ουκ εχομεν εαυτους πλανωμεν και η αληθεια ουκ εστιν εν ημιν
kjv: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

vulg: si confiteamur peccata nostra fidelis est et iustus ut remittat nobis peccata et emundet nos ab omni iniquitate
clem: Si confiteamur peccata nostra: fidelis est, et justus, ut remittat nobis peccata nostra, et emundet nos ab omni iniquitate.
tr: εαν ομολογωμεν τας αμαρτιας ημων πιστος εστιν και δικαιος ινα αφη ημιν τας αμαρτιας και καθαριση ημας απο πασης αδικιας
kjv: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

vulg: si dixerimus quoniam non peccavimus mendacem facimus eum et verbum eius non est in nobis
clem: Si dixerimus quoniam non peccavimus, mendacem facimus eum, et verbum ejus non est in nobis.
tr: εαν ειπωμεν οτι ουχ ημαρτηκαμεν ψευστην ποιουμεν αυτον και ο λογος αυτου ουκ εστιν εν ημιν
kjv: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

vulg: filioli mei haec scribo vobis ut non peccetis sed et si quis peccaverit advocatum habemus apud Patrem Iesum Christum iustum
clem: Filioli mei, hc scribo vobis, ut non peccetis. Sed et si quis peccaverit, advocatum habemus apud Patrem, Jesum Christum justum:
tr: τεκνια μου ταυτα γραφω υμιν ινα μη αμαρτητε και εαν τις αμαρτη παρακλητον εχομεν προς τον πατερα ιησουν χριστον δικαιον
kjv: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

vulg: et ipse est propitiatio pro peccatis nostris non pro nostris autem tantum sed etiam pro totius mundi
clem: et ipse est propitiatio pro peccatis nostris: non pro nostris autem tantum, sed etiam pro totius mundi.
tr: και αυτος ιλασμος εστιν περι των αμαρτιων ημων ου περι των ημετερων δε μονον αλλα και περι ολου του κοσμου
kjv: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

vulg: et in hoc scimus quoniam cognovimus eum si mandata eius observemus
clem: Et in hoc scimus quoniam cognovimus eum, si mandata ejus observemus.
tr: και εν τουτω γινωσκομεν οτι εγνωκαμεν αυτον εαν τας εντολας αυτου τηρωμεν
kjv: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

vulg: qui dicit se nosse eum et mandata eius non custodit mendax est in hoc veritas non est
clem: Qui dicit se nosse eum, et mandata ejus non custodit, mendax est, et in hoc veritas non est.
tr: ο λεγων εγνωκα αυτον και τας εντολας αυτου μη τηρων ψευστης εστιν και εν τουτω η αληθεια ουκ εστιν
kjv: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

vulg: qui autem servat verbum eius vere in hoc caritas Dei perfecta est in hoc scimus quoniam in ipso sumus
clem: Qui autem servat verbum ejus, vere in hoc caritas Dei perfecta est: et in hoc scimus quoniam in ipso sumus.
tr: ος δ αν τηρη αυτου τον λογον αληθως εν τουτω η αγαπη του θεου τετελειωται εν τουτω γινωσκομεν οτι εν αυτω εσμεν
kjv: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

vulg: qui dicit se in ipso manere debet sicut ille ambulavit et ipse ambulare
clem: Qui dicit se in ipso manere, debet, sicut ille ambulavit, et ipse ambulare.
tr: ο λεγων εν αυτω μενειν οφειλει καθως εκεινος περιεπατησεν και αυτος ουτως περιπατειν
kjv: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

vulg: carissimi non mandatum novum scribo vobis sed mandatum vetus quod habuistis ab initio mandatum vetus est verbum quod audistis
clem: Carissimi, non mandatum novum scribo vobis, sed mandatum vetus, quod habuistis ab initio. Mandatum vetus est verbum, quod audistis.
tr: αδελφοι ουκ εντολην καινην γραφω υμιν αλλ εντολην παλαιαν ην ειχετε απ αρχης η εντολη η παλαια εστιν ο λογος ον ηκουσατε απ αρχης
kjv: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

vulg: iterum mandatum novum scribo vobis quod est verum et in ipso et in vobis quoniam tenebrae transeunt et lumen verum iam lucet
clem: Iterum mandatum novum scribo vobis, quod verum est et in ipso, et in vobis: quia tenebr transierunt, et verum lumen jam lucet.
tr: παλιν εντολην καινην γραφω υμιν ο εστιν αληθες εν αυτω και εν υμιν οτι η σκοτια παραγεται και το φως το αληθινον ηδη φαινει
kjv: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

vulg: qui dicit se in luce esse et fratrem suum odit in tenebris est usque adhuc
clem: Qui dicit se in luce esse, et fratrem suum odit, in tenebris est usque adhuc.
tr: ο λεγων εν τω φωτι ειναι και τον αδελφον αυτου μισων εν τη σκοτια εστιν εως αρτι
kjv: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

vulg: qui diligit fratrem suum in lumine manet et scandalum in eo non est
clem: Qui diligit fratrem suum, in lumine manet, et scandalum in eo non est.
tr: ο αγαπων τον αδελφον αυτου εν τω φωτι μενει και σκανδαλον εν αυτω ουκ εστιν
kjv: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

vulg: qui autem odit fratrem suum in tenebris est et in tenebris ambulat et nescit quo eat quoniam tenebrae obcaecaverunt oculos eius
clem: Qui autem odit fratrem suum, in tenebris est, et in tenebris ambulat, et nescit quo eat: quia tenebr obccaverunt oculos ejus.
tr: ο δε μισων τον αδελφον αυτου εν τη σκοτια εστιν και εν τη σκοτια περιπατει και ουκ οιδεν που υπαγει οτι η σκοτια ετυφλωσεν τους οφθαλμους αυτου
kjv: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

vulg: scribo vobis filioli quoniam remittuntur vobis peccata propter nomen eius
clem: Scribo vobis, filioli, quoniam remittuntur vobis peccata propter nomen ejus.
tr: γραφω υμιν τεκνια οτι αφεωνται υμιν αι αμαρτιαι δια το ονομα αυτου
kjv: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

vulg: scribo vobis patres quoniam cognovistis eum qui ab initio est scribo vobis adulescentes quoniam vicistis malignum
clem: Scribo vobis, patres, quoniam cognovistis eum, qui ab initio est. Scribo vobis, adolescentes, quoniam vicistis malignum.
tr: γραφω υμιν πατερες οτι εγνωκατε τον απ αρχης γραφω υμιν νεανισκοι οτι νενικηκατε τον πονηρον γραφω υμιν παιδια οτι εγνωκατε τον πατερα
kjv: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

vulg: scripsi vobis infantes quoniam cognovistis Patrem scripsi vobis patres quia cognovistis eum qui ab initio scripsi vobis adulescentes quia fortes estis et verbum Dei in vobis manet et vicistis malignum
clem: Scribo vobis, infantes, quoniam cognovistis patrem. Scribo vobis juvenes, quoniam fortes estis, et verbum Dei manet in vobis, et vicistis malignum.
tr: εγραψα υμιν πατερες οτι εγνωκατε τον απ αρχης εγραψα υμιν νεανισκοι οτι ισχυροι εστε και ο λογος του θεου εν υμιν μενει και νενικηκατε τον πονηρον
kjv: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

vulg: nolite diligere mundum neque ea quae in mundo sunt si quis diligit mundum non est caritas Patris in eo
clem: Nolite diligere mundum, neque ea qu in mundo sunt. Si quis diligit mundum, non est caritas Patris in eo:
tr: μη αγαπατε τον κοσμον μηδε τα εν τω κοσμω εαν τις αγαπα τον κοσμον ουκ εστιν η αγαπη του πατρος εν αυτω
kjv: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

vulg: quoniam omne quod est in mundo concupiscentia carnis et concupiscentia oculorum est et superbia vitae quae non est ex Patre sed ex mundo est
clem: quoniam omne quod est in mundo, concupiscentia carnis est, et concupiscentia oculorum, et superbia vit: qu non est ex Patre, sed ex mundo est.
tr: οτι παν το εν τω κοσμω η επιθυμια της σαρκος και η επιθυμια των οφθαλμων και η αλαζονεια του βιου ουκ εστιν εκ του πατρος αλλ εκ του κοσμου εστιν
kjv: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

vulg: et mundus transit et concupiscentia eius qui autem facit voluntatem Dei manet in aeternum
clem: Et mundus transit, et concupiscentia ejus: qui autem facit voluntatem Dei manet in ternum.
tr: και ο κοσμος παραγεται και η επιθυμια αυτου ο δε ποιων το θελημα του θεου μενει εις τον αιωνα
kjv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

vulg: filioli novissima hora est et sicut audistis quia antichristus venit nunc antichristi multi facti sunt unde scimus quoniam novissima hora est
clem: Filioli, novissima hora est: et sicut audistis quia antichristus venit, et nunc antichristi multi facti sunt; unde scimus, quia novissima hora est.
tr: παιδια εσχατη ωρα εστιν και καθως ηκουσατε οτι ο αντιχριστος ερχεται και νυν αντιχριστοι πολλοι γεγονασιν οθεν γινωσκομεν οτι εσχατη ωρα εστιν
kjv: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

vulg: ex nobis prodierunt sed non erant ex nobis nam si fuissent ex nobis permansissent utique nobiscum sed ut manifesti sint quoniam non sunt omnes ex nobis
clem: Ex nobis prodierunt, sed non erant ex nobis, nam, si fuissent ex nobis, permansissent utique nobiscum: sed ut manifesti sint quoniam non sunt omnes ex nobis.
tr: εξ ημων εξηλθον αλλ ουκ ησαν εξ ημων ει γαρ ησαν εξ ημων μεμενηκεισαν αν μεθ ημων αλλ ινα φανερωθωσιν οτι ουκ εισιν παντες εξ ημων
kjv: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

vulg: sed vos unctionem habetis a Sancto et nostis omnia
clem: Sed vos unctionem habetis a Sancto, et nostis omnia.
tr: και υμεις χρισμα εχετε απο του αγιου και οιδατε παντα
kjv: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

vulg: non scripsi vobis quasi ignorantibus veritatem sed quasi scientibus eam et quoniam omne mendacium ex veritate non est
clem: Non scripsi vobis quasi ignorantibus veritatem, sed quasi scientibus eam: et quoniam omne mendacium ex veritate non est.
tr: ουκ εγραψα υμιν οτι ουκ οιδατε την αληθειαν αλλ οτι οιδατε αυτην και οτι παν ψευδος εκ της αληθειας ουκ εστιν
kjv: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

vulg: quis est mendax nisi is qui negat quoniam Iesus non est Christus hic est antichristus qui negat Patrem et Filium
clem: Quis est mendax, nisi is qui negat quoniam Jesus est Christus? Hic est antichristus, qui negat Patrem, et Filium.
tr: τις εστιν ο ψευστης ει μη ο αρνουμενος οτι ιησους ουκ εστιν ο χριστος ουτος εστιν ο αντιχριστος ο αρνουμενος τον πατερα και τον υιον
kjv: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

vulg: omnis qui negat Filium nec Patrem habet qui confitetur Filium et Patrem habet
clem: Omnis qui negat Filium, nec Patrem habet: qui confitetur Filium, et Patrem habet.
tr: πας ο αρνουμενος τον υιον ουδε τον πατερα εχει  ο ομολογων τον υιον και τον πατερα εχει
kjv: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.

vulg: vos quod audistis ab initio in vobis permaneat si in vobis permanserit quod ab initio audistis et vos in Filio et Patre manebitis
clem: Vos quod audistis ab initio, in vobis permaneat: si in vobis permanserit quod audistis ab initio, et vos in Filio et Patre manebitis.
tr: υμεις ουν ο ηκουσατε απ αρχης εν υμιν μενετω εαν εν υμιν μεινη ο απ αρχης ηκουσατε και υμεις εν τω υιω και εν τω πατρι μενειτε
kjv: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

vulg: et haec est repromissio quam ipse pollicitus est nobis vitam aeternam
clem: Et hc est repromissio, quam ipse pollicitus est nobis, vitam ternam.
tr: και αυτη εστιν η επαγγελια ην αυτος επηγγειλατο ημιν την ζωην την αιωνιον
kjv: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.

vulg: haec scripsi vobis de eis qui seducunt vos
clem: Hc scripsi vobis de his, qui seducant vos.
tr: ταυτα εγραψα υμιν περι των πλανωντων υμας
kjv: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

vulg: et vos unctionem quam accepistis ab eo manet in vobis et non necesse habetis ut aliquis doceat vos sed sicut unctio eius docet vos de omnibus et verum est et non est mendacium et sicut docuit vos manete in eo
clem: Et vos unctionem, quam accepistis ab eo, maneat in vobis. Et non necesse habetis ut aliquis doceat vos: sed sicut unctio ejus docet vos de omnibus, et verum est, et non est mendacium. Et sicut docuit vos: manete in eo.
tr: και υμεις το χρισμα ο ελαβετε απ αυτου εν υμιν μενει και ου χρειαν εχετε ινα τις διδασκη υμας αλλ ως το αυτο χρισμα διδασκει υμας περι παντων και αληθες εστιν και ουκ εστιν ψευδος και καθως εδιδαξεν υμας μενειτε εν αυτω
kjv: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.

vulg: et nunc filioli manete in eo ut cum apparuerit habeamus fiduciam et non confundamur ab eo in adventu eius
clem: Et nunc, filioli, manete in eo: ut cum apparuerit, habeamus fiduciam, et non confundamur ab eo in adventu ejus.
tr: και νυν τεκνια μενετε εν αυτω ινα οταν φανερωθη εχωμεν παρρησιαν και μη αισχυνθωμεν απ αυτου εν τη παρουσια αυτου
kjv: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

vulg: si scitis quoniam iustus est scitote quoniam et omnis qui facit iustitiam ex ipso natus est
clem: Si scitis quoniam justus est, scitote quoniam et omnis, qui facit justitiam, ex ipso natus est.
tr: εαν ειδητε οτι δικαιος εστιν γινωσκετε οτι πας ο ποιων την δικαιοσυνην εξ αυτου γεγεννηται
kjv: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.

vulg: videte qualem caritatem dedit nobis Pater ut filii Dei nominemur et sumus propter hoc mundus non novit nos quia non novit eum
clem: Videte qualem caritatem dedit nobis Pater, ut filii Dei nominemur et simus. Propter hoc mundus non novit nos: quia non novit eum.
tr: ιδετε ποταπην αγαπην δεδωκεν ημιν ο πατηρ ινα τεκνα θεου κληθωμεν δια τουτο ο κοσμος ου γινωσκει ημας οτι ουκ εγνω αυτον
kjv: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

vulg: carissimi nunc filii Dei sumus et nondum apparuit quid erimus scimus quoniam cum apparuerit similes ei erimus quoniam videbimus eum sicuti est
clem: Carissimi, nunc filii Dei sumus: et nondum apparuit quid erimus. Scimus quoniam cum apparuerit, similes ei erimus: quoniam videbimus eum sicuti est.
tr: αγαπητοι νυν τεκνα θεου εσμεν και ουπω εφανερωθη τι εσομεθα οιδαμεν δε οτι εαν φανερωθη ομοιοι αυτω εσομεθα οτι οψομεθα αυτον καθως εστιν
kjv: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

vulg: et omnis qui habet spem hanc in eo sanctificat se sicut et ille sanctus est
clem: Et omnis qui habet hanc spem in eo, sanctificat se, sicut et ille sanctus est.
tr: και πας ο εχων την ελπιδα ταυτην επ αυτω αγνιζει εαυτον καθως εκεινος αγνος εστιν
kjv: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

vulg: omnis qui facit peccatum et iniquitatem facit et peccatum est iniquitas
clem: Omnis qui facit peccatum, et iniquitatem facit: et peccatum est iniquitas.
tr: πας ο ποιων την αμαρτιαν και την ανομιαν ποιει και η αμαρτια εστιν η ανομια
kjv: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

vulg: et scitis quoniam ille apparuit ut peccata tolleret et peccatum in eo non est
clem: Et scitis quia ille apparuit ut peccata nostra tolleret: et peccatum in eo non est.
tr: και οιδατε οτι εκεινος εφανερωθη ινα τας αμαρτιας ημων αρη και αμαρτια εν αυτω ουκ εστιν
kjv: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

vulg: omnis qui in eo manet non peccat omnis qui peccat non vidit eum nec cognovit eum
clem: Omnis qui in eo manet, non peccat: et omnis qui peccat, non vidit eum, nec cognovit eum.
tr: πας ο εν αυτω μενων ουχ αμαρτανει πας ο αμαρτανων ουχ εωρακεν αυτον ουδε εγνωκεν αυτον
kjv: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

vulg: filioli nemo vos seducat qui facit iustitiam iustus est sicut et ille iustus est
clem: Filioli, nemo vos seducat. Qui facit justitiam, justus est, sicut et ille justus est.
tr: τεκνια μηδεις πλανατω υμας ο ποιων την δικαιοσυνην δικαιος εστιν καθως εκεινος δικαιος εστιν
kjv: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

vulg: qui facit peccatum ex diabolo est quoniam ab initio diabolus peccat in hoc apparuit Filius Dei ut dissolvat opera diaboli
clem: Qui facit peccatum, ex diabolo est: quoniam ab initio diabolus peccat. In hoc apparuit Filius Dei, ut dissolvat opera diaboli.
tr: ο ποιων την αμαρτιαν εκ του διαβολου εστιν οτι απ αρχης ο διαβολος αμαρτανει εις τουτο εφανερωθη ο υιος του θεου ινα λυση τα εργα του διαβολου
kjv: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

vulg: omnis qui natus est ex Deo peccatum non facit quoniam semen ipsius in eo manet et non potest peccare quoniam ex Deo natus est
clem: Omnis qui natus est ex Deo, peccatum non facit: quoniam semen ipsius in eo manet, et non potest peccare, quoniam ex Deo natus est.
tr: πας ο γεγεννημενος εκ του θεου αμαρτιαν ου ποιει οτι σπερμα αυτου εν αυτω μενει και ου δυναται αμαρτανειν οτι εκ του θεου γεγεννηται
kjv: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

vulg: in hoc manifesti sunt filii Dei et filii diaboli omnis qui non est iustus non est de Deo et qui non diligit fratrem suum
clem: In hoc manifesti sunt filii Dei, et filii diaboli. Omnis qui non est justus, non est ex Deo, et qui non diligit fratrem suum:
tr: εν τουτω φανερα εστιν τα τεκνα του θεου και τα τεκνα του διαβολου πας ο μη ποιων δικαιοσυνην ουκ εστιν εκ του θεου και ο μη αγαπων τον αδελφον αυτου
kjv: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

vulg: quoniam haec est adnuntiatio quam audistis ab initio ut diligamus alterutrum
clem: quoniam hc est annuntiatio, quam audistis ab initio, ut diligatis alterutrum.
tr: οτι αυτη εστιν η αγγελια ην ηκουσατε απ αρχης ινα αγαπωμεν αλληλους
kjv: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

vulg: non sicut Cain ex maligno erat et occidit fratrem suum et propter quid occidit eum quoniam opera eius maligna erant fratris autem eius iusta
clem: Non sicut Cain, qui ex maligno erat, et occidit fratrem suum. Et propter quid occidit eum? Quoniam opera ejus maligna erant: fratris autem ejus, justa.
tr: ου καθως καιν εκ του πονηρου ην και εσφαξεν τον αδελφον αυτου και χαριν τινος εσφαξεν αυτον οτι τα εργα αυτου πονηρα ην τα δε του αδελφου αυτου δικαια
kjv: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

vulg: nolite mirari fratres si odit vos mundus
clem: Nolite mirari, fratres, si odit vos mundus.
tr: μη θαυμαζετε αδελφοι μου ει μισει υμας ο κοσμος
kjv: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

vulg: nos scimus quoniam translati sumus de morte in vitam quoniam diligimus fratres qui non diligit manet in morte
clem: Nos scimus quoniam translati sumus de morte ad vitam, quoniam diligimus fratres. Qui non diligit, manet in morte:
tr: ημεις οιδαμεν οτι μεταβεβηκαμεν εκ του θανατου εις την ζωην οτι αγαπωμεν τους αδελφους ο μη αγαπων τον αδελφον μενει εν τω θανατω
kjv: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.

vulg: omnis qui odit fratrem suum homicida est et scitis quoniam omnis homicida non habet vitam aeternam in se manentem
clem: omnis qui odit fratrem suum, homicida est. Et scitis quoniam omnis homicida non habet vitam ternam in semetipso manentem.
tr: πας ο μισων τον αδελφον αυτου ανθρωποκτονος εστιν και οιδατε οτι πας ανθρωποκτονος ουκ εχει ζωην αιωνιον εν αυτω μενουσαν
kjv: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

vulg: in hoc cognovimus caritatem quoniam ille pro nobis animam suam posuit et nos debemus pro fratribus animas ponere
clem: In hoc cognovimus caritatem Dei, quoniam ille animam suam pro nobis posuit: et nos debemus pro fratribus animas ponere.
tr: εν τουτω εγνωκαμεν την αγαπην  του θεου  οτι εκεινος υπερ ημων την ψυχην αυτου εθηκεν και ημεις οφειλομεν υπερ των αδελφων τας ψυχας τιθεναι
kjv: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

vulg: qui habuerit substantiam mundi et viderit fratrem suum necesse habere et clauserit viscera sua ab eo quomodo caritas Dei manet in eo
clem: Qui habuerit substantiam hujus mundi, et viderit fratrem suum necessitatem habere, et clauserit viscera sua ab eo: quomodo caritas Dei manet in eo?
tr: ος δ αν εχη τον βιον του κοσμου και θεωρη τον αδελφον αυτου χρειαν εχοντα και κλειση τα σπλαγχνα αυτου απ αυτου πως η αγαπη του θεου μενει εν αυτω
kjv: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

vulg: filioli non diligamus verbo nec lingua sed opere et veritate
clem: Filioli mei, non diligamus verbo neque lingua, sed opere et veritate:
tr: τεκνια μου μη αγαπωμεν λογω μηδε γλωσση αλλ εργω και αληθεια
kjv: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

vulg: in hoc cognoscimus quoniam ex veritate sumus et in conspectu eius suadeamus corda nostra
clem: in hoc cognoscimus quoniam ex veritate sumus: et in conspectu ejus suadebimus corda nostra.
tr: και εν τουτω γινωσκομεν οτι εκ της αληθειας εσμεν και εμπροσθεν αυτου πεισομεν τας καρδιας ημων
kjv: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

vulg: quoniam si reprehenderit nos cor maior est Deus corde nostro et novit omnia
clem: Quoniam si reprehenderit nos cor nostrum: major est Deus corde nostro, et novit omnia.
tr: οτι εαν καταγινωσκη ημων η καρδια οτι μειζων εστιν ο θεος της καρδιας ημων και γινωσκει παντα
kjv: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

vulg: carissimi si cor non reprehenderit nos fiduciam habemus ad Deum
clem: Carissimi, si cor nostrum non reprehenderit nos, fiduciam habemus ad Deum:
tr: αγαπητοι εαν η καρδια ημων μη καταγινωσκη ημων παρρησιαν εχομεν προς τον θεον
kjv: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.

vulg: et quodcumque petierimus accipiemus ab eo quoniam mandata eius custodimus et ea quae sunt placita coram eo facimus
clem: et quidquid petierimus, accipiemus ab eo: quoniam mandata ejus custodimus, et ea, qu sunt placita coram eo, facimus.
tr: και ο εαν αιτωμεν λαμβανομεν παρ αυτου οτι τας εντολας αυτου τηρουμεν και τα αρεστα ενωπιον αυτου ποιουμεν
kjv: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

vulg: et hoc est mandatum eius ut credamus in nomine Filii eius Iesu Christi et diligamus alterutrum sicut dedit mandatum nobis
clem: Et hoc est mandatum ejus: ut credamus in nomine Filii ejus Jesu Christi: et diligamus alterutrum, sicut dedit mandatum nobis.
tr: και αυτη εστιν η εντολη αυτου ινα πιστευσωμεν τω ονοματι του υιου αυτου ιησου χριστου και αγαπωμεν αλληλους καθως εδωκεν εντολην ημιν
kjv: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

vulg: et qui servat mandata eius in illo manet et ipse in eo et in hoc scimus quoniam manet in nobis de Spiritu quem nobis dedit
clem: Et qui servat mandata ejus, in illo manet, et ipse in eo: et in hoc scimus quoniam manet in nobis, de Spiritu quem dedit nobis.
tr: και ο τηρων τας εντολας αυτου εν αυτω μενει και αυτος εν αυτω και εν τουτω γινωσκομεν οτι μενει εν ημιν εκ του πνευματος ου ημιν εδωκεν
kjv: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.

vulg: carissimi nolite omni spiritui credere sed probate spiritus si ex Deo sint quoniam multi pseudoprophetae exierunt in mundum
clem: Carissimi, nolite omni spiritui credere, sed probate spiritus si ex Deo sint: quoniam multi pseudoprophet exierunt in mundum.
tr: αγαπητοι μη παντι πνευματι πιστευετε αλλα δοκιμαζετε τα πνευματα ει εκ του θεου εστιν οτι πολλοι ψευδοπροφηται εξεληλυθασιν εις τον κοσμον
kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

vulg: in hoc cognoscitur Spiritus Dei omnis spiritus qui confitetur Iesum Christum in carne venisse ex Deo est
clem: In hoc cognoscitur Spiritus Dei: omnis spiritus qui confitetur Jesum Christum in carne venisse, ex Deo est:
tr: εν τουτω γινωσκετε  το πνευμα του θεου παν πνευμα ο ομολογει ιησουν χριστον εν σαρκι εληλυθοτα εκ του θεου εστιν
kjv: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

vulg: et omnis spiritus qui solvit Iesum ex Deo non est et hoc est antichristi quod audistis quoniam venit et nunc iam in mundo est
clem: et omnis spiritus qui solvit Jesum, ex Deo non est, et hic est antichristus, de quo audistis quoniam venit, et nunc jam in mundo est.
tr: και παν πνευμα ο μη ομολογει τον ιησουν χριστον εν σαρκι εληλυθοτα εκ του θεου ουκ εστιν και τουτο εστιν το του αντιχριστου ο ακηκοατε οτι ερχεται και νυν εν τω κοσμω εστιν ηδη
kjv: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

vulg: vos ex Deo estis filioli et vicistis eos quoniam maior est qui in vobis est quam qui in mundo
clem: Vos ex Deo estis filioli, et vicistis eum, quoniam major est qui in vobis est, quam qui in mundo.
tr: υμεις εκ του θεου εστε τεκνια και νενικηκατε αυτους οτι μειζων εστιν ο εν υμιν η ο εν τω κοσμω
kjv: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

vulg: ipsi de mundo sunt ideo de mundo loquuntur et mundus eos audit
clem: Ipsi de mundo sunt: ideo de mundo loquuntur, et mundus eos audit.
tr: αυτοι εκ του κοσμου εισιν δια τουτο εκ του κοσμου λαλουσιν και ο κοσμος αυτων ακουει
kjv: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.

vulg: nos ex Deo sumus qui novit Deum audit nos qui non est ex Deo non audit nos in hoc cognoscimus Spiritum veritatis et spiritum erroris
clem: Nos ex Deo sumus. Qui novit Deum, audit nos; qui non est ex Deo, non audit nos: in hoc cognoscimus Spiritum veritatis, et spiritum erroris.
tr: ημεις εκ του θεου εσμεν ο γινωσκων τον θεον ακουει ημων ος ουκ εστιν εκ του θεου ουκ ακουει ημων εκ τουτου γινωσκομεν το πνευμα της αληθειας και το πνευμα της πλανης
kjv: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

vulg: carissimi diligamus invicem quoniam caritas ex Deo est et omnis qui diligit ex Deo natus est et cognoscit Deum
clem: Carissimi, diligamus nos invicem: quia caritas ex Deo est. Et omnis qui diligit, ex Deo natus est, et cognoscit Deum.
tr: αγαπητοι αγαπωμεν αλληλους οτι η αγαπη εκ του θεου εστιν και πας ο αγαπων εκ του θεου γεγεννηται και γινωσκει τον θεον
kjv: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

vulg: qui non diligit non novit Deum quoniam Deus caritas est
clem: Qui non diligit, non novit Deum: quoniam Deus caritas est.
tr: ο μη αγαπων ουκ εγνω τον θεον οτι ο θεος αγαπη εστιν
kjv: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

vulg: in hoc apparuit caritas Dei in nobis quoniam Filium suum unigenitum misit Deus in mundum ut vivamus per eum
clem: In hoc apparuit caritas Dei in nobis, quoniam Filium suum unigenitum misit Deus in mundum, ut vivamus per eum.
tr: εν τουτω εφανερωθη η αγαπη του θεου εν ημιν οτι τον υιον αυτου τον μονογενη απεσταλκεν ο θεος εις τον κοσμον ινα ζησωμεν δι αυτου
kjv: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

vulg: in hoc est caritas non quasi nos dilexerimus Deum sed quoniam ipse dilexit nos et misit Filium suum propitiationem pro peccatis nostris
clem: In hoc est caritas: non quasi nos dilexerimus Deum, sed quoniam ipse prior dilexit nos, et misit Filium suum propitiationem pro peccatis nostris.
tr: εν τουτω εστιν η αγαπη ουχ οτι ημεις ηγαπησαμεν τον θεον αλλ οτι αυτος ηγαπησεν ημας και απεστειλεν τον υιον αυτου ιλασμον περι των αμαρτιων ημων
kjv: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

vulg: carissimi si sic Deus dilexit nos et nos debemus alterutrum diligere
clem: Carissimi, si sic Deus dilexit nos: et nos debemus alterutrum diligere.
tr: αγαπητοι ει ουτως ο θεος ηγαπησεν ημας και ημεις οφειλομεν αλληλους αγαπαν
kjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

vulg: Deum nemo vidit umquam si diligamus invicem Deus in nobis manet et caritas eius in nobis perfecta est
clem: Deum nemo vidit umquam. Si diligamus invicem, Deus in nobis manet, et caritas ejus in nobis perfecta est.
tr: θεον ουδεις πωποτε τεθεαται εαν αγαπωμεν αλληλους ο θεος εν ημιν μενει και η αγαπη αυτου τετελειωμενη εστιν εν ημιν
kjv: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

vulg: in hoc intellegimus quoniam in eo manemus et ipse in nobis quoniam de Spiritu suo dedit nobis
clem: In hoc cognoscimus quoniam in eo manemus, et ipse in nobis: quoniam de Spiritu suo dedit nobis.
tr: εν τουτω γινωσκομεν οτι εν αυτω μενομεν και αυτος εν ημιν οτι εκ του πνευματος αυτου δεδωκεν ημιν
kjv: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

vulg: et nos vidimus et testificamur quoniam Pater misit Filium salvatorem mundi
clem: Et vos vidimus, et testificamur quoniam Pater misit Filium suum Salvatorem mundi.
tr: και ημεις τεθεαμεθα και μαρτυρουμεν οτι ο πατηρ απεσταλκεν τον υιον σωτηρα του κοσμου
kjv: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

vulg: quisque confessus fuerit quoniam Iesus est Filius Dei Deus in eo manet et ipse in Deo
clem: Quisquis confessus fuerit quoniam Jesus est Filius Dei, Deus in eo manet, et ipse in Deo.
tr: ος αν ομολογηση οτι ιησους εστιν ο υιος του θεου ο θεος εν αυτω μενει και αυτος εν τω θεω
kjv: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

vulg: et nos cognovimus et credidimus caritati quam habet Deus in nobis Deus caritas est et qui manet in caritate in Deo manet et Deus in eo
clem: Et nos cognovimus, et credidimus caritati, quam habet Deus in nobis. Deus caritas est: et qui manet in caritate, in Deo manet, et Deus in eo.
tr: και ημεις εγνωκαμεν και πεπιστευκαμεν την αγαπην ην εχει ο θεος εν ημιν ο θεος αγαπη εστιν και ο μενων εν τη αγαπη εν τω θεω μενει και ο θεος εν αυτω
kjv: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

vulg: in hoc perfecta est caritas nobiscum ut fiduciam habeamus in die iudicii quia sicut ille est et nos sumus in hoc mundo
clem: In hoc perfecta est caritas Dei nobiscum, ut fiduciam habeamus in die judicii: quia sicut ille est, et nos sumus in hoc mundo.
tr: εν τουτω τετελειωται η αγαπη μεθ ημων ινα παρρησιαν εχωμεν εν τη ημερα της κρισεως οτι καθως εκεινος εστιν και ημεις εσμεν εν τω κοσμω τουτω
kjv: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

vulg: timor non est in caritate sed perfecta caritas foras mittit timorem quoniam timor poenam habet qui autem timet non est perfectus in caritate
clem: Timor non est in caritate: sed perfecta caritas foras mittit timorem, quoniam timor pnam habet: qui autem timet, non est perfectus in caritate.
tr: φοβος ουκ εστιν εν τη αγαπη αλλ η τελεια αγαπη εξω βαλλει τον φοβον οτι ο φοβος κολασιν εχει ο δε φοβουμενος ου τετελειωται εν τη αγαπη
kjv: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

vulg: nos ergo diligamus quoniam Deus prior dilexit nos
clem: Nos ergo diligamus Deum, quoniam Deus prior dilexit nos.
tr: ημεις αγαπωμεν αυτον οτι αυτος πρωτος ηγαπησεν ημας
kjv: We love him, because he first loved us.

vulg: si quis dixerit quoniam diligo Deum et fratrem suum oderit mendax est qui enim non diligit fratrem suum quem vidit Deum quem non vidit quomodo potest diligere
clem: Si quis dixerit, Quoniam diligo Deum, et fratrem suum oderit, mendax est. Qui enim non diligit fratrem suum quem vidit, Deum, quem non vidit, quomodo potest diligere?
tr: εαν τις ειπη οτι αγαπω τον θεον και τον αδελφον αυτου μιση ψευστης εστιν ο γαρ μη αγαπων τον αδελφον αυτου ον εωρακεν τον θεον ον ουχ εωρακεν πως δυναται αγαπαν
kjv: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

vulg: et hoc mandatum habemus ab eo ut qui diligit Deum diligat et fratrem suum
clem: Et hoc mandatum habemus a Deo: ut qui diligit Deum, diligat et fratrem suum.
tr: και ταυτην την εντολην εχομεν απ αυτου ινα ο αγαπων τον θεον αγαπα και τον αδελφον αυτου
kjv: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

vulg: omnis qui credit quoniam Iesus est Christus ex Deo natus est et omnis qui diligit eum qui genuit diligit eum qui natus est ex eo
clem: Omnis qui credit quoniam Jesus est Christus, ex Deo natus est. Et omnis qui diligit eum qui genuit, diligit et eum qui natus est ex eo.
tr: πας ο πιστευων οτι ιησους εστιν ο χριστος εκ του θεου γεγεννηται και πας ο αγαπων τον γεννησαντα αγαπα  και τον γεγεννημενον εξ αυτου
kjv: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

vulg: in hoc cognoscimus quoniam diligimus natos Dei cum Deum diligamus et mandata eius faciamus
clem: In hoc cognoscimus quoniam diligamus natos Dei, cum Deum diligamus, et mandata ejus faciamus.
tr: εν τουτω γινωσκομεν οτι αγαπωμεν τα τεκνα του θεου οταν τον θεον αγαπωμεν και τας εντολας αυτου τηρωμεν
kjv: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.

vulg: haec est enim caritas Dei ut mandata eius custodiamus et mandata eius gravia non sunt
clem: Hc est enim caritas Dei, ut mandata ejus custodiamus: et mandata ejus gravia non sunt.
tr: αυτη γαρ εστιν η αγαπη του θεου ινα τας εντολας αυτου τηρωμεν και αι εντολαι αυτου βαρειαι ουκ εισιν
kjv: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

vulg: quoniam omne quod natum est ex Deo vincit mundum et haec est victoria quae vincit mundum fides nostra
clem: Quoniam omne quod natum est ex Deo, vincit mundum: et hc est victoria, qu vincit mundum, fides nostra.
tr: οτι παν το γεγεννημενον εκ του θεου νικα τον κοσμον και αυτη εστιν η νικη η νικησασα τον κοσμον η πιστις ημων
kjv: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

vulg: quis est qui vincit mundum nisi qui credit quoniam Iesus est Filius Dei
clem: Quis est, qui vincit mundum, nisi qui credit quoniam Jesus est Filius Dei?
tr: τις εστιν ο νικων τον κοσμον ει μη ο πιστευων οτι ιησους εστιν ο υιος του θεου
kjv: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

vulg: hic est qui venit per aquam et sanguinem Iesus Christus non in aqua solum sed in aqua et sanguine et Spiritus est qui testificatur quoniam Christus est veritas
clem: Hic est, qui venit per aquam et sanguinem, Jesus Christus: non in aqua solum, sed in aqua et sanguine. Et Spiritus est, qui testificatur quoniam Christus est veritas.
tr: ουτος εστιν ο ελθων δι υδατος και αιματος ιησους ο χριστος ουκ εν τω υδατι μονον αλλ εν τω υδατι και τω αιματι και το πνευμα εστιν το μαρτυρουν οτι το πνευμα εστιν η αληθεια
kjv: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

vulg: quia tres sunt qui testimonium dant
clem: Quoniam tres sunt, qui testimonium dant in clo: Pater, Verbum, et Spiritus Sanctus: et hi tres unum sunt.
tr: οτι τρεις εισιν οι μαρτυρουντες εν τω ουρανω ο πατηρ ο λογος και το αγιον πνευμα και ουτοι οι τρεις εν εισιν
kjv: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.

vulg: Spiritus et aqua et sanguis et tres unum sunt
clem: Et tres sunt, qui testimonium dant in terra: spiritus, et aqua, et sanguis: et hi tres unum sunt.
tr: και τρεις εισιν οι μαρτυρουντες εν τη γη το πνευμα και το υδωρ και το αιμα και οι τρεις εις το εν εισιν
kjv: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

vulg: si testimonium hominum accipimus testimonium Dei maius est quoniam hoc est testimonium Dei quod maius est quia testificatus est de Filio suo
clem: Si testimonium hominum accipimus, testimonium Dei majus est: quoniam hoc est testimonium Dei, quod majus est, quoniam testificatus est de Filio suo.
tr: ει την μαρτυριαν των ανθρωπων λαμβανομεν η μαρτυρια του θεου μειζων εστιν οτι αυτη εστιν η μαρτυρια του θεου ην μεμαρτυρηκεν περι του υιου αυτου
kjv: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.

vulg: qui credit in Filio Dei habet testimonium Dei in se qui non credit Filio mendacem facit eum quoniam non credidit in testimonio quod testificatus est Deus de Filio suo
clem: Qui credit in Filium Dei, habet testimonium Dei in se. Qui non credit Filio, mendacem facit eum: quia non credit in testimonium quod testificatus est Deus de Filio suo.
tr: ο πιστευων εις τον υιον του θεου εχει την μαρτυριαν εν εαυτω ο μη πιστευων τω θεω ψευστην πεποιηκεν αυτον οτι ου πεπιστευκεν εις την μαρτυριαν ην μεμαρτυρηκεν ο θεος περι του υιου αυτου
kjv: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.

vulg: et hoc est testimonium quoniam vitam aeternam dedit nobis Deus et haec vita in Filio eius est
clem: Et hoc est testimonium, quoniam vitam ternam dedit nobis Deus: et hc vita in Filio ejus est.
tr: και αυτη εστιν η μαρτυρια οτι ζωην αιωνιον εδωκεν ημιν ο θεος και αυτη η ζωη εν τω υιω αυτου εστιν
kjv: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

vulg: qui habet Filium habet vitam qui non habet Filium Dei vitam non habet
clem: Qui habet Filium, habet vitam: qui non habet Filium, vitam non habet.
tr: ο εχων τον υιον εχει την ζωην ο μη εχων τον υιον του θεου την ζωην ουκ εχει
kjv: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

vulg: haec scripsi vobis ut sciatis quoniam vitam habetis aeternam qui creditis in nomine Filii Dei
clem: Hc scribo vobis ut sciatis quoniam vitam habetis ternam, qui creditis in nomine Filii Dei.
tr: ταυτα εγραψα υμιν τοις πιστευουσιν εις το ονομα του υιου του θεου ινα ειδητε οτι ζωην εχετε αιωνιον και ινα πιστευητε εις το ονομα του υιου του θεου
kjv: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

vulg: et haec est fiducia quam habemus ad eum quia quodcumque petierimus secundum voluntatem eius audit nos
clem: Et hc est fiducia, quam habemus ad eum: quia quodcumque petierimus, secundum voluntatem ejus, audit nos.
tr: και αυτη εστιν η παρρησια ην εχομεν προς αυτον οτι εαν τι αιτωμεθα κατα το θελημα αυτου ακουει ημων
kjv: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

vulg: et scimus quoniam audit nos quicquid petierimus scimus quoniam habemus petitiones quas postulavimus ab eo
clem: Et scimus quia audit nos quidquid petierimus: scimus quoniam habemus petitiones quas postulamus ab eo.
tr: και εαν οιδαμεν οτι ακουει ημων ο αν αιτωμεθα οιδαμεν οτι εχομεν τα αιτηματα α ητηκαμεν παρ αυτου
kjv: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

vulg: qui scit fratrem suum peccare peccatum non ad mortem petet et dabit ei vitam peccantibus non ad mortem est peccatum ad mortem non pro illo dico ut roget
clem: Qui scit fratrem suum peccare peccatum non ad mortem, petat, et dabitur ei vita peccanti non ad mortem. Est peccatum ad mortem: non pro illo dico ut roget quis.
tr: εαν τις ιδη τον αδελφον αυτου αμαρτανοντα αμαρτιαν μη προς θανατον αιτησει και δωσει αυτω ζωην τοις αμαρτανουσιν μη προς θανατον εστιν αμαρτια προς θανατον ου περι εκεινης λεγω ινα ερωτηση
kjv: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

vulg: omnis iniquitas peccatum est et est peccatum non ad mortem
clem: Omnis iniquitas, peccatum est: et est peccatum ad mortem.
tr: πασα αδικια αμαρτια εστιν και εστιν αμαρτια ου προς θανατον
kjv: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

vulg: scimus quoniam omnis qui natus est ex Deo non peccat sed generatio Dei conservat eum et malignus non tangit eum
clem: Scimus quia omnis qui natus est ex Deo, non peccat: sed generatio Dei conservat eum, et malignus non tangit eum.
tr: οιδαμεν οτι πας ο γεγεννημενος εκ του θεου ουχ αμαρτανει αλλ ο γεννηθεις εκ του θεου τηρει εαυτον και ο πονηρος ουχ απτεται αυτου
kjv: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

vulg: scimus quoniam ex Deo sumus et mundus totus in maligno positus est
clem: Scimus quoniam ex Deo sumus: et mundus totus in maligno positus est.
tr: οιδαμεν οτι εκ του θεου εσμεν και ο κοσμος ολος εν τω πονηρω κειται
kjv: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

vulg: et scimus quoniam Filius Dei venit et dedit nobis sensum ut cognoscamus verum Deum et simus in vero Filio eius hic est verus Deus et vita aeterna
clem: Et scimus quoniam Filius Dei venit, et dedit nobis sensum ut cognoscamus verum Deum, et simus in vero Filio ejus. Hic est verus Deus, et vita terna.
tr: οιδαμεν δε οτι ο υιος του θεου ηκει και δεδωκεν ημιν διανοιαν ινα γινωσκωμεν τον αληθινον και εσμεν εν τω αληθινω εν τω υιω αυτου ιησου χριστω ουτος εστιν ο αληθινος θεος και η ζωη αιωνιος
kjv: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

vulg: filioli custodite vos a simulacris
clem: Filioli, custodite vos a simulacris. Amen.
tr: τεκνια φυλαξατε εαυτους απο των ειδωλων αμην
kjv: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
